items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Professor Minetta said he uses a quarter...

ctx.x: See, this one is too round. I don't know, you may, you may can do it, but you can tell. Because, but this cap is just right. So I just take it and put that reed on there, just about how much I want. And take a match and light it. And I just point it all the way around. Just a little tip in it. Ralph and I were laughing one day, let's see.

Somebody said a nickel and I think... No, a nickel is too small. A nickel is too small. Professor Minetta said he uses a quarter and the baby dogs. I never got to talk to Johnny much about it. I knew Johnny quite well, but never in those days I went to hear it.

I use a half a dollar, we'll do it. Johnny used a half a dollar, baby said. Yeah, that's right. I use a half a dollar. But this particular cap that I got is a German made cap. It's just right. Because it's shaped just like, just like the reed when I bought it. And if you both do it right, that's alright. Of course they got another thing too that you can buy to cut a reed.
